_comment: Gate for `run.mjs --gate`. atLeast: the weakest acceptable attack outcome (OPEN < LIMITED < BLOCKED). knownFalsePositive: a control that is a FALSE_POSITIVE by design or deferred, with the reason; any OTHER false positive fails the gate. Measured values and the reasoning live in docs/P7_TRUST_SOCIAL_FOUNDATION.md (B1 evidence).

LEG-09.knownFalsePositive: Bulk bans are capped by the moderation limiter (30/min per moderator+address), which also bounds a compromised moderator account. Raid mode already stops a raid's posting, so cleanup at that rate is harmless; a single audited bulk raid-cleanup action is P7 B5 (moderation tooling).

LEG-11.knownFalsePositive: Deliberate trade-off: brand-new accounts (< 24 h) that join inside a detected join surge are indistinguishable from raiders by join rate, so they can join and read but not post until raid mode ends (10 min) or a moderator ends it, which the lab shows releasing every hold. Established accounts in the same surge (LEG-10) are unaffected.
